evidence.V1: Clear flower silhouette (bloom, stem, two leaves) from front, three-quarter, top and silhouette.
evidence.V2: Bloom as the big read, stem and leaves medium, gold centre small - clear hierarchy.
evidence.V3: Bloom proportions are good but the stem is a perfectly straight uniform cylinder and the leaves are flat cards, so the plant reads stiff.
evidence.V4: Petals have hard faceted creases while the leaves are paper-thin razor edges; no consistent rounded edge treatment.
evidence.V5: bloom_flat shows petals interpenetrating with jagged zig-zag intersections and faceted petal planes; leaves pierce the stem.
evidence.V6: Petal hue in 2-3 values, leaf green secondary, gold centre accent - disciplined across colourways.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material and kit hues match, but the faceted petals and razor leaf cards do not match the smooth fused shells of the nature kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, Box fidelity, Color white, SmoothPlastic - correct foliage flags.

artifacts: Jagged petal-petal intersections in bloom close-up
Leaf cards razor-thin, left leaf pierces the stem
top_fixes: Rebuild petals as smooth cupped shells that overlap cleanly (or fuse into one bloom shell) to remove jagged intersections
Give the stem a slight curve/taper and the leaves some thickness and a midrib fold
Add a small leaf base or sepal ring under the bloom to tie head to stem
